part.name: fixture_part
part.what_it_is: Synthetic test plate with a through bore ({{params:plate_x.value}} × {{params:plate_y.value}} mm). Not a real part.

method_summary: Datum: plate top face (primary), bore axis (secondary), long edge clocks +X.
Parameters from calipers where given, scan otherwise; see the source column.
build123d box minus cylinder; both frames exported and re-imported.
Two-way deviation on the full-resolution scan, regime {{gate:regime.name}}.

limitations.text: Bore diameter {{params:bore_d.value}} mm is assumed; the scan does not resolve it. Tier1 partial: only 2 of 3 dims are gated (the bore is not calipered).
limitations.rerun_trigger: One caliper reading of the bore diameter; a value different from the model triggers a re-run.

assumptions.text: Plate corners are sharp (no fillet was measured).

not_fit_for: any physical use; the bore is not calipered
